files.README.md:
# mongophp-mongodb-from-model2db

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories and services with the MongoDB PHP library, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             opens the database DATABASE_URL names
src/Db.php                   a database and the session of its transaction
src/Documents.php            values as MongoDB stores them, what changed, and the rules of nested documents
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Entities/                one entity per table
src/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/Services/                one service per table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mongodb://localhost:27017/app" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A page of a list: the rows from an offset, and how many there are in all.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Page
{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.
     *
     * @template R
     * @param callable(T): R $mapper
     * @return Page<R>
     */
    public function map(callable $mapper): self
    {
        return new self(array_map($mapper, $this->items), $this->total, $this->offset, $this->limit);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A field of an update: absent (it keeps its value), or present with a value, which may be null.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Patch
{
    /** An absent field; use Patch::of() for one with a value. */
    public function __construct(public bool $isPresent = false, public mixed $value = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The field keeps its value.
     *
     * @return Patch<mixed>
     */
    public static function absent(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    /**
     * The field takes this value, which may be null.
     *
     * @template V
     * @param V $value
     * @return Patch<V>
     */
    public static function of(mixed $value): self
    {
        return new self(true, $value);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use MongoDB\Client;

/** The MongoDB database DATABASE_URL names. It creates no collection and no index: the database already exists. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'mongodb://localhost:27017/app';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** The name of the database a URL names. */
    public static function name(string $url): string
    {
        if (preg_match('#^mongodb(?:\+srv)?://[^/]+/([^?]+)#', $url, $found) !== 1) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The URL names no database');
        }
        return rawurldecode($found[1]);
    }

    /** A Db over the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null), one per unit of work; the driver keeps the connections. */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): Db
    {
        $url ??= self::url();
        return new Db((new Client($url))->selectDatabase(self::name($url)));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use MongoDB\Collection;
use MongoDB\Driver\Exception\BulkWriteException;
use MongoDB\Driver\Exception\CommandException;
use MongoDB\Driver\Exception\InvalidArgumentException;
use MongoDB\Driver\Session;
use MongoDB\Operation\FindOneAndUpdate;

/** A database and the session of its transaction, when there is one (MongoDB has them on replica sets only). A refused write is a ConflictException. */
final class Db
{
    private ?Session $session = null;

    public function __construct(public readonly \MongoDB\Database $database)
    {
    }

    public function inTransaction(): bool
    {
        return $this->session !== null;
    }

    public function begin(): void
    {
        $this->session = $this->database->getManager()->startSession();
        $this->session->startTransaction();
    }

    public function commit(): void
    {
        $this->session?->commitTransaction();
        $this->session = null;
    }

    public function rollBack(): void
    {
        if ($this->session?->isInTransaction()) {
            $this->session->abortTransaction();
        }
        $this->session = null;
    }

    public function collection(string $name): Collection
    {
        return $this->database->selectCollection($name, ['typeMap' => ['root' => 'array', 'document' => 'array', 'array' => 'array']]);
    }

    /**
     * The documents of a collection.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filter
     * @param array<string, mixed> $options
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function find(string $collection, array $filter, array $options = []): array
    {
        return $this->collection($collection)->find($filter, $this->options($options))->toArray();
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $filter */
    public function count(string $collection, array $filter): int
    {
        return $this->collection($collection)->countDocuments($filter, $this->options());
    }

    /** @param callable(): array<string, mixed> $document */
    public function insert(string $entity, string $collection, callable $document): void
    {
        $this->write($entity, fn () => $this->collection($collection)->insertOne($document(), $this->options()));
    }

    /**
     * Changes one document; inside write().
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filter
     * @param array<string, mixed> $change
     */
    public function update(string $collection, array $filter, array $change): void
    {
        $this->collection($collection)->updateOne($filter, $change, $this->options());
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $filter */
    public function delete(string $entity, string $collection, array $filter): void
    {
        $this->write($entity, fn () => $this->collection($collection)->deleteOne($filter, $this->options()));
    }

    /**
     * Changes one document where it is, and gives it as it is then; null when there is none.
     *
     * @param callable(): array{array<string, mixed>, array<mixed>} $change its filter and its change
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function change(string $entity, string $collection, callable $change): ?array
    {
        return $this->write($entity, fn () => $this->collection($collection)->findOneAndUpdate(
            ...[...$change(), $this->options(['returnDocument' => FindOneAndUpdate::RETURN_DOCUMENT_AFTER])],
        ));
    }

    /** Runs a write: a repeated value, or one the validator of the collection does not take, is a ConflictException; a text that is no identifier or number, a ValidationFailedException. */
    public function write(string $entity, callable $work): mixed
    {
        try {
            return $work();
        } catch (BulkWriteException|CommandException $error) {
            $codes = [$error->getCode()];
            if ($error instanceof BulkWriteException) {
                foreach ($error->getWriteResult()->getWriteErrors() as $refusal) {
                    $codes[] = $refusal->getCode();
                }
            }
            if (array_intersect($codes, [11000, 121]) === []) {
                throw $error;
            }
            throw new ConflictException($entity, 'the database refused the change: ' . $error->getMessage());
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $error) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException($entity, [new FieldError('', $error->getMessage())]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $options
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function options(array $options = []): array
    {
        return $this->session === null ? $options : [...$options, 'session' => $this->session];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Errors\FieldError;
use MongoDB\BSON\Binary;
use MongoDB\BSON\Decimal128;
use MongoDB\BSON\Document;
use MongoDB\BSON\Int64;
use MongoDB\BSON\ObjectId;
use MongoDB\BSON\UTCDateTime;

/** Values as MongoDB stores them and as PHP has them, what changed in a document, and the rules of the documents inside others. */
final class Documents
{
    /** Whether a text is an identifier (an ObjectId). */
    public static function isId(mixed $value): bool
    {
        return is_string($value) && preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{24}$/iD', $value) === 1;
    }

    /** A value as MongoDB stores it, by its shape: a kind, the `items` of a list or the `fields` of a document. What no shape names stays as it is. */
    public static function toBson(mixed $value, string|array|null $shape): mixed
    {
        if ($value === null || $shape === null) {
            return $value;
        }
        if (is_array($shape)) {
            if (!is_array($value)) {
                return $value;
            }
            if (isset($shape['items'])) {
                return array_map(fn (mixed $item) => self::toBson($item, $shape['items']), array_values($value));
            }
            $document = [];
            foreach ($value as $name => $item) {
                $known = array_key_exists($name, $shape['fields']);
                // A field without a value is left out
                if (!$known || $item !== null) {
                    $document[$name] = $known ? self::toBson($item, $shape['fields'][$name]) : $item;
                }
            }
            // An empty array would be a list
            return $document === [] ? new \stdClass() : $document;
        }
        return match ($shape) {
            'objectId' => $value instanceof ObjectId ? $value : new ObjectId((string) $value),
            'decimal' => $value instanceof Decimal128 ? $value : new Decimal128((string) $value),
            'uuid' => $value instanceof Binary ? $value : new Binary((string) hex2bin(str_replace('-', '', $value)), Binary::TYPE_UUID),
            'binary' => $value instanceof Binary ? $value : new Binary($value, Binary::TYPE_GENERIC),
            'datetime' => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? new UTCDateTime($value) : $value,
            'long' => is_int($value) ? new Int64($value) : $value,
            'double' => is_int($value) ? (float) $value : $value,
            default => $value,
        };
    }

    /** A value of MongoDB as PHP has it, by its shape. */
    public static function fromBson(mixed $value, string|array|null $shape): mixed
    {
        if (is_array($shape) && is_array($value)) {
            if (isset($shape['items'])) {
                return array_map(fn (mixed $item) => self::fromBson($item, $shape['items']), array_values($value));
            }
            foreach ($value as $name => $item) {
                $value[$name] = self::fromBson($item, $shape['fields'][$name] ?? null);
            }
            return $value;
        }
        if ($value === null || $shape === null) {
            return $value;
        }
        return match (true) {
            $value instanceof ObjectId, $value instanceof Decimal128 => (string) $value,
            $value instanceof UTCDateTime => \DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($value->toDateTime()),
            $value instanceof Binary => $shape === 'uuid' ? vsprintf('%s%s-%s-%s-%s-%s%s%s', str_split(bin2hex($value->getData()), 4)) : $value->getData(),
            $value instanceof Int64 => (int) (string) $value,
            $shape === 'double' && is_int($value) => (float) $value,
            $shape === 'int' && is_float($value), $shape === 'long' && is_float($value) => (int) $value,
            $shape === 'decimal' => (string) $value,
            default => $value,
        };
    }

    /**
     * The update that takes a document from what it was to what it is: only the fields that differ, and inside a nested document only its own.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $before
     * @param array<string, mixed> $now
     * @param list<string> $fields
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function changes(array $before, array $now, array $fields): array
    {
        $changes = ['$set' => [], '$unset' => []];
        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            self::compare('', $field, $before, $now, $changes);
        }
        return array_filter($changes, fn (array $items) => $items !== []);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<mixed> $before
     * @param array<mixed> $now
     * @param array<string, array<string, mixed>> $changes
     */
    private static function compare(string $path, int|string $field, array $before, array $now, array &$changes): void
    {
        $old = $before[$field] ?? null;
        $current = $now[$field] ?? null;
        $bytes = fn (mixed $value) => (string) Document::fromPHP(['value' => $value]);
        if ($bytes($old) === $bytes($current)) {
            return;
        }
        $name = $path . $field;
        if ($current === null) {
            $changes['$unset'][$name] = '';
        } elseif (is_array($old) && is_array($current) && !array_is_list($old) && !array_is_list($current)) {
            foreach (array_keys($old + $current) as $item) {
                self::compare($name . '.', $item, $old, $current, $changes);
            }
        } else {
            $changes['$set'][$name] = $current;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Gives an identifier to the documents of a list that have none: MongoDB numbers only whole documents.
     *
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>>|null $items
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>|null
     */
    public static function identify(?array $items): ?array
    {
        return $items === null ? null : array_map(fn (mixed $item) => is_array($item) && !isset($item['_id']) ? [...$item, '_id' => (string) new ObjectId()] : $item, array_values($items));
    }

    /**
     * What a value does not follow of its rule, each with the path of its field (`lines.0.quantity`). Fields the rules do not name are left alone.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $rule
     * @return list<FieldError>
     */
    public static function problems(mixed $value, array $rule, string $path): array
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return isset($rule['required']) ? [new FieldError($path, 'is required')] : [];
        }
        $errors = [];
        if (isset($rule['items'])) {
            if (!is_array($value) || !array_is_list($value)) {
                return [new FieldError($path, 'must be a list')];
            }
            foreach ($value as $index => $item) {
                $errors = [...$errors, ...self::problems($item, [...$rule['items'], 'required' => true], "{$path}.{$index}")];
            }
        }
        if (isset($rule['fields'])) {
            if (!is_array($value) || ($value !== [] && array_is_list($value))) {
                return [new FieldError($path, 'must be a document')];
            }
            foreach ($rule['fields'] as $name => $field) {
                $errors = [...$errors, ...self::problems($value[$name] ?? null, $field, "{$path}.{$name}")];
            }
        }
        if (isset($rule['values']) && !in_array($value, $rule['values'])) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError($path, 'must be one of: ' . implode(', ', $rule['values']));
        }
        $limits = [
            'min' => ['>=', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value >= $limit],
            'above' => ['>', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value > $limit],
            'max' => ['<=', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value <= $limit],
            'below' => ['<', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value < $limit],
        ];
        foreach ($limits as $name => [$sign, $fits]) {
            if (isset($rule[$name]) && !$fits((float) $rule[$name])) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError($path, "must be {$sign} {$rule[$name]}");
            }
        }
        if (isset($rule['minLength']) && mb_strlen((string) $value) < $rule['minLength']) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError($path, "must have >= {$rule['minLength']} characters");
        }
        if (isset($rule['maxLength']) && mb_strlen((string) $value) > $rule['maxLength']) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError($path, "is longer than {$rule['maxLength']} characters");
        }
        return $errors;
    }
}

{

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Author;

/** Where authors rows are kept. Services depend only on this interface. */
interface AuthorRepository
{
    /** The row with this primary key, or null. */
    public function findById(string $id): ?Author;

    /**
     * At most $limit rows from $offset, by primary key, and how many there are.
     *
     * @return Page<Author>
     */
    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page;

    /** Stores a new row; the values the database fills are read back. */
    public function insert(Author $entity): Author;

    /** Stores the changes made to a row read from this repository. */
    public function update(Author $entity): Author;

    /** Removes a row read from this repository. */
    public function delete(Author $entity): void;
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Author;

/** Keeps authors rows in memory, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
final class MemoryAuthorRepository implements AuthorRepository
{
    /** @var array<string, Author> */
    private array $rows = [];

    /**
     * The key of a row, as a list of its key values.
     *
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    private static function keyOf(Author $row): array
    {
        return [$row->id];
    }

    private static function keyText(Author $row): string
    {
        return serialize(array_map(fn (mixed $value) => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? $value->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.u P') : $value, self::keyOf($row)));
    }

    /**
     * The rows reads can see, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<Author>
     */
    private function visible(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->rows, fn (Author $row) => true));
        usort($rows, fn (Author $a, Author $b) => self::keyOf($a) <=> self::keyOf($b));
        return $rows;
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?Author
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $rows = $this->visible();
        return new Page(array_slice($rows, $offset, $limit), count($rows), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function insert(Author $entity): Author
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Author $entity): Author
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Author $entity): void
    {
        unset($this->rows[self::keyText($entity)]);
    }
}

    }

    /**
     * The rows reads can see, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<Post>
     */
    private function visible(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->rows, fn (Post $row) => true));
        usort($rows, fn (Post $a, Post $b) => self::keyOf($a) <=> self::keyOf($b));
        return $rows;
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?Post
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $rows = $this->visible();
        return new Page(array_slice($rows, $offset, $limit), count($rows), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function listByAuthor(string $author): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($this->visible(), fn (Post $row) => $row->author == $author));
    }

    public function insert(Post $entity): Post
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Post $entity): Post
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Post $entity): void
    {
        unset($this->rows[self::keyText($entity)]);
    }

    public function addComment(string $id, array $comment): ?Post
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                $row->comments = [...($row->comments ?? []), $comment];
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function removeComment(string $id, int $position, int $size): ?Post
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id && count($row->comments ?? []) === $size) {
                $row->comments = array_values(array_diff_key($row->comments ?? [], [$position => true]));
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Db;
use App\Documents;
use App\Entities\Author;

/** Keeps authors rows in the database, through the MongoDB library. A write joins the transaction already open, or is committed at once. */
final class MongoAuthorRepository implements AuthorRepository
{
    /** What each field is in MongoDB, when it is not what PHP has */
    private const SHAPE = [
        '_id' => 'uuid',
        'email' => null,
    ];

    /** The fields a change may write */
    private const FIELDS = ['email'];

    /**
     * The document each entity was read from: a change writes only the fields that differ.
     *
     * @var \WeakMap<Author, array<string, mixed>>|null
     */
    private static ?\WeakMap $read = null;

    public function __construct(private readonly Db $db)
    {
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?Author
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('authors', ['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'uuid')], ['limit' => 1]))[0] ?? null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $items = $limit > 0 ? array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('authors', [], ['sort' => ['_id' => 1], 'skip' => $offset, 'limit' => $limit])) : [];
        return new Page($items, $this->db->count('authors', []), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function insert(Author $entity): Author
    {
        $this->db->insert('Author', 'authors', fn () => self::document($entity));
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function update(Author $entity): Author
    {
        $this->db->write('Author', function () use ($entity): void {
            $now = self::document($entity);
            $changes = Documents::changes(self::$read[$entity] ?? [], $now, self::FIELDS);
            if ($changes === []) {
                return;
            }
            $this->db->update('authors', ['_id' => $now['_id']], $changes);
        });
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function delete(Author $entity): void
    {
        $this->db->delete('Author', 'authors', ['_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, 'uuid')]);
    }

    /**
     * The Author of a document.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $document
     */
    private static function entity(array $document): Author
    {
        $entity = new Author();
        $entity->id = Documents::fromBson($document['_id'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['_id']);
        $entity->email = Documents::fromBson($document['email'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['email']);
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    /**
     * The document of a Author: what is null is left out.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function document(Author $entity): array
    {
        return array_filter([
            '_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, self::SHAPE['_id']),
            'email' => Documents::toBson($entity->email, self::SHAPE['email']),
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
    }

    /** The same entity, with what it is stored as kept to tell its changes. */
    private static function loaded(Author $entity): Author
    {
        self::$read ??= new \WeakMap();
        self::$read[$entity] = self::document($entity);
        return $entity;
    }
}

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Db;
use App\Documents;
use App\Entities\Post;

/** Keeps posts rows in the database, through the MongoDB library. A write joins the transaction already open, or is committed at once. */
final class MongoPostRepository implements PostRepository
{
    /** What each field is in MongoDB, when it is not what PHP has */
    private const SHAPE = [
        '_id' => 'uuid',
        'title' => null,
        'author' => 'uuid',
        'published_at' => 'datetime',
        'comments' => ['items' => ['fields' => ['id' => 'uuid', 'text' => null, 'marks' => ['items' => 'uuid']]]],
    ];

    /** The fields a change may write */
    private const FIELDS = ['title', 'author', 'published_at', 'comments'];

    /**
     * The document each entity was read from: a change writes only the fields that differ.
     *
     * @var \WeakMap<Post, array<string, mixed>>|null
     */
    private static ?\WeakMap $read = null;

    public function __construct(private readonly Db $db)
    {
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?Post
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('posts', ['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'uuid')], ['limit' => 1]))[0] ?? null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $items = $limit > 0 ? array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('posts', [], ['sort' => ['_id' => 1], 'skip' => $offset, 'limit' => $limit])) : [];
        return new Page($items, $this->db->count('posts', []), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function listByAuthor(string $author): array
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('posts', ['author' => Documents::toBson($author, 'uuid')], ['sort' => ['_id' => 1]]));
    }

    public function insert(Post $entity): Post
    {
        $this->db->insert('Post', 'posts', fn () => self::document($entity));
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function update(Post $entity): Post
    {
        $this->db->write('Post', function () use ($entity): void {
            $now = self::document($entity);
            $changes = Documents::changes(self::$read[$entity] ?? [], $now, self::FIELDS);
            if ($changes === []) {
                return;
            }
            $this->db->update('posts', ['_id' => $now['_id']], $changes);
        });
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function delete(Post $entity): void
    {
        $this->db->delete('Post', 'posts', ['_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, 'uuid')]);
    }

    public function addComment(string $id, array $comment): ?Post
    {
        $document = $this->db->change('Post', 'posts', fn () => [['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'uuid')], ['$push' => ['comments' => Documents::toBson($comment, ['fields' => ['id' => 'uuid', 'text' => null, 'marks' => ['items' => 'uuid']]])]]]);
        return $document === null ? null : self::entity($document);
    }

    public function removeComment(string $id, int $position, int $size): ?Post
    {
        $document = $this->db->change('Post', 'posts', fn () => [['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'uuid'), 'comments' => ['$size' => $size]], [['$set' => ['comments' => ['$concatArrays' => [['$slice' => ['$comments', $position]], ['$slice' => ['$comments', $position + 1, max($size, 1)]]]]]]]]);
        return $document === null ? null : self::entity($document);
    }

    /**
     * The Post of a document.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $document
     */
    private static function entity(array $document): Post
    {
        $entity = new Post();
        $entity->id = Documents::fromBson($document['_id'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['_id']);
        $entity->title = Documents::fromBson($document['title'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['title']);
        $entity->author = Documents::fromBson($document['author'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['author']);
        $entity->publishedAt = Documents::fromBson($document['published_at'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['published_at']);
        $entity->comments = Documents::fromBson($document['comments'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['comments']);
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    /**
     * The document of a Post: what is null is left out.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function document(Post $entity): array
    {
        return array_filter([
            '_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, self::SHAPE['_id']),
            'title' => Documents::toBson($entity->title, self::SHAPE['title']),
            'author' => Documents::toBson($entity->author, self::SHAPE['author']),
            'published_at' => Documents::toBson($entity->publishedAt, self::SHAPE['published_at']),
            'comments' => Documents::toBson($entity->comments, self::SHAPE['comments']),
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
    }

    /** The same entity, with what it is stored as kept to tell its changes. */
    private static function loaded(Post $entity): Post
    {
        self::$read ??= new \WeakMap();
        self::$read[$entity] = self::document($entity);
        return $entity;
    }
}

namespace App\Repositories;

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Author;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on authors. Repositories commit every write. */
final class AuthorService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "authors" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Author $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['id'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('id', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('_id', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['email'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('email', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('email', 'is required');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Author', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Author $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Author $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('id', $values)) {
            $entity->id = $values['id'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('email', $values)) {
            $entity->email = $values['email'];
        }
    }

    /** The Author with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, string $id): Author
    {
        return $uow->authors->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Author', $id);
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(AuthorChanges $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->email->isPresent) {
            $values['email'] = $changes->email->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Author after checking it. */
    public function createAuthor(Author $author): Author
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'id' => $author->id,
            'email' => $author->email,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $author): Author {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->authors->insert($author);
        });
    }

    /** The Author with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getAuthor(string $id): Author
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $id);
    }

    /**
     * A page of authors, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<Author>
     */
    public function listAuthors(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->authors->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Author. */
    public function updateAuthor(string $id, AuthorChanges $changes): Author
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): Author {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->authors->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Author. */
    public function deleteAuthor(string $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if ($uow->posts->listByAuthor($current->id) !== []) {
                throw new ConflictException('Author', 'rows of posts still point to it', ['posts']);
            }
            $uow->authors->delete($current);
        });
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Documents;
use App\Entities\Post;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on posts. Repositories commit every write. */
final class PostService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "posts" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Post $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['id'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('id', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('_id', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['title'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('title', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('title', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['author'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('author', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('author', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['comments'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('comments', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('comments', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['items' => ['fields' => ['id' => ['required' => true], 'text' => ['required' => true], 'marks' => ['required' => true, 'items' => []]]]], 'comments')];
        }
        $author = array_key_exists('author', $values) ? $values['author'] : $current?->author;
        if ($author !== null && $uow->authors->findById($author) === null) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError('author', 'no Author has this key');
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Post', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Post $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Post $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('id', $values)) {
            $entity->id = $values['id'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('title', $values)) {
            $entity->title = $values['title'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('author', $values)) {
            $entity->author = $values['author'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('publishedAt', $values)) {
            $entity->publishedAt = $values['publishedAt'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('comments', $values)) {
            $entity->comments = $values['comments'];
        }
    }

    /** The Post with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, string $id): Post
    {
        return $uow->posts->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Post', $id);
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(PostChanges $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->title->isPresent) {
            $values['title'] = $changes->title->value;
        }
        if ($changes->author->isPresent) {
            $values['author'] = $changes->author->value;
        }
        if ($changes->publishedAt->isPresent) {
            $values['publishedAt'] = $changes->publishedAt->value;
        }
        if ($changes->comments->isPresent) {
            $values['comments'] = $changes->comments->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Post after checking it. */
    public function createPost(Post $post): Post
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'id' => $post->id,
            'title' => $post->title,
            'author' => $post->author,
            'publishedAt' => $post->publishedAt,
            'comments' => $post->comments,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $post): Post {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->posts->insert($post);
        });
    }

    /** The Post with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getPost(string $id): Post
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $id);
    }

    /**
     * A page of posts, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<Post>
     */
    public function listPosts(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->posts->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Post. */
    public function updatePost(string $id, PostChanges $changes): Post
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): Post {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->posts->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Post. */
    public function deletePost(string $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            $uow->posts->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /**
     * The posts with this author.
     *
     * @return list<Post>
     */
    public function listPostsByAuthor(string $author): array
    {
        return $this->uow->posts->listByAuthor($author);
    }

    /** Adds an item to comments. */
    public function addComment(string $id, array $comment): Post
    {
        $errors = Documents::problems($comment, ['fields' => ['id' => ['required' => true], 'text' => ['required' => true], 'marks' => ['required' => true, 'items' => []]]], 'comments');
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Post', $errors);
        }
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $comment): Post {
            self::find($uow, $id);
            return $uow->posts->addComment($id, $comment) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Post', $id);
        });
    }

    /** Removes an item from comments, by its position. */
    public function removeComment(string $id, int $position): Post
    {
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $position): Post {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if (!array_key_exists($position, ($current->comments ?? []))) {
                throw new NotFoundException('Comment', $position);
            }
            return $uow->posts->removeComment($id, $position, count(($current->comments ?? []))) ?? throw new ConflictException('Post', 'was changed by someone else since it was read', ['comments']);
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Repositories\AuthorRepository;
use App\Repositories\PostRepository;

/** What services depend on: a repository per table and a transaction. Every repository write is committed at once; transaction() only groups the code. */
interface UnitOfWork
{
    public AuthorRepository $authors { get; }
    public PostRepository $posts { get; }

    /**
     * Runs work with the repositories of the transaction; commits when it ends, rolls back when it throws.
     *
     * @template T
     * @param callable(UnitOfWork): T $work
     * @return T
     */
    public function transaction(callable $work): mixed;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Entities\Author;
use App\Entities\Post;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Rows for the tests: valid values for every column, and the rows they point to. */
final class Factories
{
    /** A valid Author that is not stored yet; $n makes its unique values differ. */
    public static function newAuthor(int $n): Author
    {
        $entity = new Author();
        $entity->id = sprintf('00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d', $n);
        $entity->email = "email-{$n}";
        return $entity;
    }

    /** A stored Author. */
    public static function addAuthor(UnitOfWork $uow, int $n): Author
    {
        $entity = self::newAuthor($n);
        return $uow->authors->insert($entity);
    }

    /** A valid Post that is not stored yet; $n makes its unique values differ. */
    public static function newPost(int $n): Post
    {
        $entity = new Post();
        $entity->id = sprintf('00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d', $n);
        $entity->title = "title-{$n}";
        $entity->publishedAt = new \DateTimeImmutable(sprintf('2026-01-%02d 12:00:00', $n % 28 + 1));
        $entity->comments = [['id' => sprintf('00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d', $n), 'text' => "text-{$n}", 'marks' => []]];
        return $entity;
    }

    /** A stored Post, with the rows it points to. */
    public static function addPost(UnitOfWork $uow, int $n): Post
    {
        $parent0 = self::addAuthor($uow, $n);
        $entity = self::newPost($n);
        $entity->author = $parent0->id;
        return $uow->posts->insert($entity);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\MongoUnitOfWork;

/** The test database: the MongoDB database TEST_DATABASE_URL names, with every collection created empty before every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with its collections and their indexes created again. */
    public static function open(): MongoUnitOfWork
    {
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The database tests need a disposable MongoDB database (a replica set, for its transactions): set TEST_DATABASE_URL (it is emptied)'));
        $db->database->drop();
        $db->database->createCollection('authors');
        $db->database->createCollection('posts');
        $db->collection('posts')->createIndex(['author' => 1], ['name' => 'ix_posts_author']);
        return new MongoUnitOfWork($db);
    }
}
